messages.cli.herald.summary: Run the Herald: the world's server on 127.0.0.1 (port kingdom.herald.port), answering only browsers that were paired (elvaria herald pair). Runs until Ctrl+C. 0 mana.
messages.cli.herald.option.port: The port for this run instead of kingdom.herald.port; 0 picks a free one.
messages.cli.herald.bad_port: --port takes a number from 0 to 65535, not «{value}».
messages.cli.herald.port_in_use: Port {port} is in use ({code}): another Herald or program listens there. Stop it, or run with --port <another port>.
messages.cli.herald.start_failed: The Herald could not open port {port} ({code}).
messages.cli.herald.listening: The Herald listens at {origin}. Ctrl+C to stop.
messages.cli.herald.pair_hint: Pair a browser: elvaria herald pair --role full --label <name>.
messages.cli.herald.log.failed: The Herald failed to answer a request: {message}
messages.cli.herald.log.stream_opened: The device {device} opened a world stream.
messages.cli.herald.log.stream_closed: The device {device} closed its world stream.
messages.cli.herald.log.command_accepted: The device {device} sent a {command} command: it is in inbox/.
messages.cli.herald.log.command_refused: The device {device} sent a {command} command: refused ({answer}).
messages.cli.herald.locked: Could not hold the lock of {file}; try again later.
messages.cli.herald.page.title: Elvaria · Herald
messages.cli.herald.page.pair_prompt: Pair this browser with the kingdom? The code works once.
messages.cli.herald.page.home: This browser is the device «{label}», role {role}.
messages.cli.herald.page.refusal.host_refused: The Herald does not answer at this address.
messages.cli.herald.page.refusal.origin_refused: The Herald takes no request from this page.
messages.cli.herald.page.refusal.no_session: This browser is not paired. On the kingdom's computer, run elvaria herald pair and open the link it prints.
messages.cli.herald.page.refusal.code_refused: The pairing code is wrong, used or expired. Run elvaria herald pair again for a new one.
messages.cli.herald.page.refusal.pairing_closed: Too many wrong codes: pairing is closed. Run elvaria herald pair again to reopen it.
messages.cli.herald.page.refusal.too_many_streams: This device has too many streams open; close a tab.
messages.cli.herald.page.refusal.failed: The Herald failed; see the window running elvaria herald.
messages.cli.herald.option.role: Role: full (everything the owner does), scoped (the work of the territories given) or inquiry (questions on the territories given).
messages.cli.herald.option.label: The name of the device, up to 64 characters (e.g. «Personal phone»).
messages.cli.herald.full_territories: The full role takes no --territory: a full device sees the whole kingdom.
messages.cli.herald.needs_territory: The {role} role needs at least one --territory.
messages.cli.herald.unknown_territory: No territory «{id}» in the kingdom; see elvaria territory list.
messages.cli.herald.pair.summary: Pair a browser or a phone: create a new device (devices/<id>.json) with its role and territories, then print a link with a one-time code, good for 5 minutes. Open it on that device while elvaria herald runs. --device <id> pairs a device that exists again (its browser lost the cookie), keeping its id, role and territories. 0 mana.
messages.cli.herald.pair.option.territory: A territory given, repeatable; scoped and inquiry need at least one, full takes none.
messages.cli.herald.pair.option.device: Pair this existing device again instead of creating one; takes no --role, --label or --territory. Without it, --role and --label are required.
messages.cli.herald.pair.device_alone: --device pairs an existing device again with its own role, territories and label: drop --role, --label and --territory (change them with elvaria herald device).
messages.cli.herald.pair.revoked: The device {id} was revoked at {at}; pair a new device instead.
messages.cli.herald.pair.open: Open one link below on that device before {expires} (the code works once; the Herald must be running on port {port}):
messages.cli.herald.devices.summary: The paired devices: role, territories given, when created, when the Herald last saw them, when revoked.
messages.cli.herald.devices.none: No device yet. Pair a browser: elvaria herald pair.
messages.cli.herald.device.summary: Show one device, or change its role, territories or label. The Herald reads the device file again at every request and the Steward at every command: a change counts at once.
messages.cli.herald.device.arg.id: The id of the device (dev_…), see elvaria herald devices.
messages.cli.herald.device.unknown: No device «{id}»; see elvaria herald devices.
messages.cli.herald.device.revoked: The device {id} was revoked at {at}; pair a new device instead of changing it.
messages.cli.herald.device.saved: Saved {id}: from the next request and command on, the Herald and the Steward use the new role.
messages.cli.herald.revoke.summary: Revoke one device, or every device with --all: the Herald ends its session at the next request and the Steward refuses its commands. The device file stays, so the log still names it.
messages.cli.herald.revoke.arg.id: The id of the device (dev_…); left out with --all.
messages.cli.herald.revoke.option.all: Revoke every device not revoked yet.
messages.cli.herald.doctor.plain_origin: Herald: the origin {origin} is neither https nor loopback: session cookies and commands would cross the network unencrypted. Use the tunnel's https origin.
